correctness.rationale: The p-adic binomial lift identity is exact. It produces p-2 distinct affine directions. Additive character orthogonality gives the exact frequency phases and three vanishing frequency lines. Rank-two versus rank-one classifications of the lift-parameter matrix exhaust all m-fold words and prove the convolution identity, including m divisible by p; Parseval proves all energies. The p=3 exception and sharp minimum for p>=5 are handled explicitly. A standalone verifier independently enumerates 33 small prime/shift cases.
